description: This file contains server-side logic for a login page in an online examination system. It handles user login for students and teachers, manages session state, and redirects users to appropriate pages based on credentials.

classes.name: LoginPage
classes.description: Code-behind class for the login page, managing user authentication and redirection.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for initial page load.

methods.name: signupB
methods.description: Event handler for signup button click, redirects to SignUpPage.

methods.name: loginButton_Click
methods.description: Event handler for login button click, authenticates user credentials for Student or Teacher.
